item.title: Lally AI Academy Applications Now Open
item.description: Have an AI idea you want to bring to life? The Lally AI Academy is a 30-day, hands-on sprint where student teams build and deploy live AI-powered products with a $500 budget, mentorship, and professional-grade tools. No coding background required! Teams must include at least one Lally student. Applications for Cohort 2 close September 15. Apply Today!

item.title: 9/11 Memorial Stair Run at The Approach
item.description: Join us on Friday, September 11, 2026, at The Approach at RPI for a 9/11 Memorial Stair Run/Walk. Everyone is welcome to participate! Participants may run, walk, or ruck the stairs. This event honors the first responders who climbed the stairs of the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001. As we take on the stairs ourselves, we remember their courage, sacrifice, and selfless service.
item.author: Community

item.title: Dean Liad Wagman to Lead Free International Webinar on Responsible AI in Research
item.description: On Friday, September 11, 10 to 11 a.m. ET, Liad Wagman, Dean of the RPI Lally School of Management, will lead a free webinar hosted by AACSB International, the global accrediting body for business schools, on how schools are moving from AI policy to daily practice. The session covers research integrity, teaching and assessment, and administration and governance, with practical approaches relevant beyond business schools. Register today!

item.title: DCC–JEC Upper Deck Walkway Closure
item.description: Beginning Monday, September 14, the upper deck walkway between Darrin Communications Center (DCC) and Jonsson Engineering Center (JEC) will be temporarily closed for approximately three weeks while construction work is completed. Pedestrian detour routes will be reinstated during the closure. Please follow all posted signage and designated alternate routes and do not enter the construction area. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

item.title: Intellectual Property and Technology Licensing (IPTL) Informational Session | Septermber 16 at 11:00 am
item.description:
Are you working on groundbreaking research? Are you curious about what happens to your ideas, inventions, research, and software at RPI? Join the Intellectual Property & Technology Licensing (IPTL) team for an informational session on the basics of intellectual property. We’ll cover patents, copyrights, invention disclosures, commercialization, and when you should contact IPTL. Join Us on Wednesday September 16th at 11:00am. Online event. Registration required.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
